title: CherryAutoMessage
body:
# 🍒 CherryAutoMessage – The Ultimate ActionBar Messaging Plugin

> CherryAutoMessage is a lightweight and fully customizable plugin designed to display rotating messages above the XP bar with style and ease. Perfect for announcements, reminders, or server promotions, it supports multiple messages, configurable intervals, color codes, and even checks for updates automatically. Fully optimized for Paper servers up to Minecraft 1.21+, CherryAutoMessage keeps your community informed without spamming chat
